key_doubts.prompt: After the defense traps the ball‑handler in the corner and the offense rotates, the scramble principle dictates that the nearest defender should:
key_doubts.answer: Tag the roller and rotate behind the ball.
verdicts: gemini: wrong (Tagging the roller is pick-and-roll coverage, whereas scramble defence after a trap denies the outlet pass and protects the rim.)
sonnet: ambiguous (Tag-the-roller is a pick-and-roll concept; sprinting to the open shooter or denying the outlet is also defensible after a trap.)
